query:
select
            (bookmarks.ap_user_id = $2) as "owner!",
            exists(
                select 1
                from links
                inner join lists on links.src_list_id = lists.id
                where not lists.private
                    and links.dest_bookmark_id = $1
            ) as "is_public!"
        from bookmarks
        where bookmarks.id = $1
